## Presentation

> This subject covers the specific aspects of the Biology curriculum in secondary education. Its purpose is to complement the disciplinary training of students in the field of biology. Professor Xavier Muñoz Báguena directs this part of the **Disciplinary Training Complements** module called **Biology**, with the objectives of knowing the curriculum of biology and environmental sciences of ESO and high school, and reflecting on the objectives of teaching-learning of natural sciences in secondary school.


## Goals

The objectives of this subject are:

* Identify the big ideas (key ideas) of Biology
    + They have explanatory power in relation to a large number of phenomena that students may encounter throughout their lives
    + Provide a good basis for understanding relevant issues (affecting health and well-being as well as the environment)
    + They provoke the satisfaction of being able to find answers to the questions they may ask about themselves and the natural, everyday world
    + They have cultural significance, that is, they are related to aspects of the human condition, great moments in the history of science, the impacts of human activity on the environment.
* Identify the aspects of Biology that will have to be studied/reviewed
    + The paradigm of Evolution
    + Cell theory and the hypothesis of chromosome continuity
    + Mendelian genetics
    + Molecular genetics. Metabolism
    + Ecology
* Know the main obstacles that students encounter
* Reflect on the way to approach different aspects of the discipline
* Analyze specific teaching-learning activities
